matrix.linux: kills the whole POSIX process group
matrix.win32: degrades to direct child only; grandchildren may survive (documented limit)

matrix.severity: P2 (covered live by dotenv-crlf on every host)

matrix.darwin: UNSIGNED + UNNOTARIZED: Gatekeeper blocks double-click; needs Apple Developer ID (Tan-side)
matrix.severity: P0-2 (blocks trusted distribution, not a code task)
